messages:
deploy-bot: kicking off incremental v2 rollout 10% -> 40% across NA/EU (rl-2026-06-v2-casefold). smoke tests enabled.
megan: note — gateway now honors X-API-Version and does case-insensitive match. we also have a temporary compat shim for requests missing the header which routes to v1.
rafael: please add explicit rollback triggers to runbook. suggested: 5xx_rate >= 1.5% for 5m OR p95 increase > 300ms for 10m.
ops-oncall: accepted. adding alert: if header_missing_pct > 7% for any tenant slice for 30m trigger CS outreach.
megan: instrumented metrics: shim_mapped_to_v1, header_missing_pct, header_case_normalized. also logging original header casing for diagnostics.
docs-bot: created release draft https://confluence.redwood.example/rl-2026-06-v2-casefold (internal). will include curl examples and SDK snippets.
cs-lead: can we surface a fast pin flow for customer support? want a one-liner to pin misbehaving tenants.
megan: pin command: `deploybot pin tenant=TENANT_ID version=v1 reason="compat-shim"`. reversible with `deploybot unpin tenant=TENANT_ID`.
rafael: emergency rollback plan in runbook: (1) `deploybot rollback rl-2026-06-v2-casefold`, (2) set `compat.allow_missing_version=false`, (3) pin top affected tenants, (4) notify CSMs + open internal incident.
ops-oncall: add step to enable maintenance banner via `maintenance_mode=true` during public rollback notifications.
megan: added sample header example for docs: `curl -H "X-API-Version: 2" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.example/v2/generate`. include note that gateway is case-insensitive.
docs-bot: also adding table of endpoints with shape changes and eval hooks to detect regressions.
cs-lead: flagging tenant=omega-retail as early adopter; if their header_missing_pct > 12% we will proactively reach out.
ops-oncall: deploybot ramp policy set to staged(10,25,15m,5m) then auto to 40%. pause between stages for 5m to validate telemetry.
deploy-bot: ramp to 25% completed. metrics snapshot: 5xx_rate=0.0009, p95=210ms, header_missing_pct=4.1%, shim_mapped_to_v1=4.0%.
rafael: looks nominal. hold for next 15m and then continue if metrics stable.
megan: minor catch — old mobile SDKs sometimes send `x-api-version` in a meta header; we have a mapping rule but logging such cases to `header_case_mapped`.
cs-lead: please add outreach template to runbook so CS can message tenants quickly.
docs-bot: added slack and email templates to the confluence draft.
ops-oncall: if we see a 4xx spike correlated with shim mapping, flip off shim immediately and pin affected tenants. command is `deploybot pin ...` then `toggle compat.allow_missing_version=false`.
megan: tagging this rollout state=monitoring. I'll post a follow-up summary after 24h with header_missing_pct trends.
rafael: thanks team — good to have clear pin/rollback steps. ping @ops-oncall on any alerts. :eyes:
